data.name: Durjaya
data.long_meaning: Durjaya is a Sanskrit name that means 'invincible' or 'incomparable'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dur' (difficult) and 'jaya' (victory). This name is often given to a child who is believed to possess the strength and courage to overcome challenges and emerge victorious.
